name: [daemind] 10 - SDR & Triagem Autônoma de Leads com IA (Chatwoot + NocoDB)

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO clientes (nome, whatsapp)
VALUES ('{{$json.nome}}', '{{$json.whatsapp}}')
ON CONFLICT (whatsapp) DO UPDATE SET nome = EXCLUDED.nome, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP;

INSERT INTO fila_mensageria (event_type, aggregate_type, whatsapp, payload, status, idempotency_key)
VALUES (
  'lead_qualificado_sdr',
  'crm',
  '{{$json.whatsapp}}',
  '{"score": {{$json.lead_score}}, "interesse": "{{$json.interesse_principal}}", "origem": "SDR_IA"}'::jsonb,
  'concluido',
  'sdr_lead_{{$json.whatsapp}}_' || TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD')
)
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING;
